entities.summary: Benjamin Conz is a Swiss professional ice hockey goaltender who currently plays for HC Ajoie of the National League (NL). He was eligible for the 2009 NHL Entry Draft and 2010 NHL Entry Draft, but went undrafted, being drafted 185th overall in the 2010 KHL Junior Draft by SKA St. Petersburg instead.
